response.original_title: FAL OFFICE Presents マサ北宮デビュー15周年記念大会
response.overview: Masa Kitamiya 15th Anniversary Event was a professional wrestling event promoted by Pro Wrestling NOAH, held on October 18, 2026 at Takaoka Techno Dome No.2 Gymnasium in Takaoka, Toyama, Japan, commemorating the fifteenth anniversary of long-time star Masa Kitamiya's professional debut.
